name: Double field
description: Provides a field type with two separate sub-fields.
project_description:
What is Double Field? 
 Double Field is a small module written to provide extensions to Drupal's core Fields. By this module you can split your fields up into two separate parts.

 For the moment it includes the following sub-field types:

 
 Boolean 
 Text 
 Text (long) 
 Integer 
 Float 
 Decimal 
 Email 
 Telephone 
 Date 
 Url 
 
 Screenshots (Drupal 7) 
 
 Conference 
 Contextual information 
 FAQ 
 Social profiles 
 IDE 
 Links 
 Our team 
 Properties 
 Tip of the day 
 Units 
 
 Note 
 Please, do not post issues about «Triple Field», «Quadruple Field», «Quintuplet Field» and so on. This module is named «Double Field» and that's just what it'll do.

 Use drush generate field command to generate a field type with unlimited number of sub-fields.
